home.metatitle: LMS for Online Academies & Course Creators

platform.metatitle: All-in-One LMS Platform for Academies & Course Creators

platform-assess.metadescription: Create timed tests and mock exams from question banks, review assignments, add in-video quizzes and issue branded certificates automatically with LMS Domain.

platform-sell.metadescription: Sell courses on your own checkout with Stripe, Razorpay, Paytm or DOKU. Multi-currency prices, coupons, invoices and offline payments, with 0% commission.

platform-ai.metatitle: Domie AI: AI Teaching Assistant for Your Academy
platform-ai.metadescription: Domie AI answers learner questions from your own course content, drafts course descriptions and flags learners falling behind. Available on LMS Domain Pro.

platform-security.metatitle: Secure LMS with Video Watermarking & Device Limits
platform-security.metadescription: Protect course videos with learner watermarks and device limits, control team access with roles, and keep academy data on secure managed hosting with LMS Domain.
